blocks.text: The companions who follow Sukha Singh enter the battle determined to be counted among the martyrs rather than to preserve themselves at any cost. Their charge briefly shakes the Afghan line and gives the page its fierce momentum, because the assault is driven by chosen sacrifice rather than by hope of easy victory.

In the confusion of combat, Sukha Singh presses toward Ahmad Shah Abdali himself and tries to strike at the center of enemy power. The effort ends in martyrdom, but the attack leaves a lasting memory precisely because it carries the Khalsa spirit into the heart of the danger.

After the clash, the survivors must disengage and begin a retreat towards Lahore under pressure. The page therefore combines heroic advance and painful withdrawal, preserving both the audacity of the attempt and the cost it exacted.
